event.name: Design & Deploy Workshop
event.description:
Turn your idea into a working product using AI. In this hands-on workshop, you will learn how to design, build, and deploy a modern web application using AI-powered development tools.

You will go through the complete process of building a product — from creating ideas and designing interfaces to adding functionality, connecting backend services, and launching your application.

During the workshop, you will use AI tools to create designs, build your application, add features, and deploy a working prototype. You will learn a practical AI-powered workflow that you can use to quickly turn ideas into real products.

This workshop is designed for founders, designers, developers, students, and anyone interested in building with AI. Bring your laptop and an idea, or create one during the session.
event.location: Homebrew Club, 111 Maiden Ln #540, San Francisco, CA 94108

sponsors.companyDescription: ​InsForge is building agent-native cloud infrastructure for modern AI development. It brings together model gateway, compute, deployment, database, authentication, and more so AI coding agents can operate across the full development workflow.
​Replit helps builders create, collaborate, and deploy software directly from the browser. At Wizard Hackathon, Replit gives participants credits to move faster from idea to working product.

Lovable is an AI-powered application development platform that enables users to build full-stack web applications using natural language. By describing an idea in plain English, developers and non-developers can generate production-ready applications with frontend, backend, database integration, and authentication—without starting from scratch.

Google AI Studio is Google's web-based platform for building, testing, and deploying applications powered by Gemini AI models. It provides an intuitive environment for prompt engineering, model experimentation, and API integration, making it easy to prototype and integrate generative AI into applications.
